title: Kojagiri Night Celebration
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar celebrated Kojagiri Night on 24th October 2026 at Prabodhankar Sankul, an evening of music, fun and fellowship for members and families.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar celebrated Kojagiri Night on 24th October 2026 at Prabodhankar Sankul, an evening of music, fun and fellowship for members and families. The highlight was a lively musical programme of solos and duets by Nagesh Pinge, Nitin Kharde, Dr. Tony Parmar, Shailesh Guagarkar, Vicky Pai, B. G. Barve, Sushil Deshpande, Dr. Kalpana Bhatwadekar, Avinaash Mishra, Rutvi Mishra, Prasad Velankar, Sailee Velankar, Shrikant Bhagwat, and Priya Kulkarni revealing our members’ hidden talents. Avinaash Mishra and Dr. Monika Tandon compered the evening, Renu and Pooja handled the welcome, and Moha Kamat led the delicious food arrangements. Special thanks to Rtn. Prasad Devrukhakar for coordinating the music, and to President Rtn. Sundeep Gokhale and the organising team. A true celebration of the spirit of Rotary and Kojagiri!
